<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#08080C"/>

  <text x="20" y="22" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">9:41</text>

  <rect x="19" y="111" width="352" height="458" rx="8" fill="#000000" opacity=".35" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <rect x="19" y="108" width="352" height="458" rx="8" fill="#181825" stroke="#303045" stroke-width="1"/>

  <circle cx="195" cy="160" r="32" fill="#7A57DD" opacity=".18"/>

  <line x1="195" y1="151" x2="195" y2="161" stroke="#C8C7D8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="167" r="1.5" fill="#C8C7D8"/>

  <text x="195" y="212" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="18px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">Deposit initiated</text>
  <text x="195" y="235" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="450" fill="#AFAEC0">Waiting for network confirmations</text>

  <circle cx="47" cy="273" r="16" fill="#7A57DD"/>
  <text x="47" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Ξ</text>

  <text x="73" y="291" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="18px" font-weight="500" fill="#FAFAFD">2.5000 ETH</text>
  <text x="337" y="289" text-anchor="end" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#AFAEC0">≈ $8,615.25</text>

  <text x="43" y="333" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#C8C7D8">CONFIRMATIONS</text>
  <text x="346" y="333" text-anchor="end" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="500" fill="#3ED9A4">3 / 10</text>

  <text x="43" y="457" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Collateral balance</text>
  <text x="347" y="457" text-anchor="end" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="500" fill="#C8C7D8">+$8,615.25</text>

  <text x="43" y="484" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Available to trade</text>
  <text x="347" y="484" text-anchor="end" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="500" fill="#C8C7D8">Pending</text>

  <text x="43" y="511" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Network fee</text>
  <text x="347" y="511" text-anchor="end" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="500" fill="#C8C7D8">0.0018 ETH</text>

  <text x="43" y="556" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Transaction</text>
  <text x="347" y="556" text-anchor="end" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#AFAEC0">0x7a91...c42e</text>

  <circle cx="34" cy="601" r="9" fill="#6966FF" opacity=".2"/>
  <text x="34" y="605" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="500" fill="#6966FF">i</text>
  <text x="51" y="601" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#AFAEC0">Your funds will be available after the</text>
  <text x="51" y="620" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="450" fill="#AFAEC0">required confirmations are complete.</text>

  </g>
  <g>

    <text x="284" y="677" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14.5px" font-weight="500" fill="#08080C">Close</text>

  <rect x="0" y="738" width="390" height="106" fill="#181825" stroke="#303045" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g>
    <polygon points="31,771 44,761 57,771" fill="none" stroke="#3ED9A4" stroke-width="1.7"/>

    <text x="44" y="806" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="500" fill="#3ED9A4">Portfolio</text>
  </g>

    <text x="116" y="806" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Trade</text>

    <text x="277" y="806" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Activity</text>
  </g>

    <circle cx="347" cy="766" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="347" cy="780" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#807E98" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="347" y="806" text-anchor="middle" font-family="CircularXX, Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11px" font-weight="450" fill="#807E98">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="0" y="834" width="390" height="10" fill="#101018"/>
